additional.text: Seal Ring (unlocked in the Seal Ritual): In the inventory, place a material into this gear’s slot to convert it in battle into a stat buff for the party (various rarity of materials give differing stat buffs to the party). The material’s stat begins at 100% its value.

The rune will float above the equipping character’s head and provide an unremovable buff [Holy Aura]. By sensing magic signatures, the rune’s power discerns weaknesses: nearby opponents will have an element resistance reduction of -15% matching the equipping character’s affinity. In trade, 5 MP will drain every 2 seconds to maintain effect.

Magnitude: The amount of [Shield] gain contributes to extending the duration of buffs on the party, +1 second whenever gaining an amount equal to or above 5% of the equipping character’s max health (Cooldown: 5 seconds).

[Holy Aura] Unremovable Buff - Increases all stats by +3%, and an extra +0.5% for every 10 levels on the weapon. When the character attacks with Basic Attack, there is a 25% chance to dispel a buff on hit opponents (Duration: Infinite).
